resources.string: LagLess needs Usage Access permission to detect which apps you haven\'t used recently. Tap the button below to grant it in Settings.
LagLess needs storage permission to scan folders and find junk files on your device.
Are you sure you want to delete the selected files? This action cannot be undone.
Note: Android\'s security model prevents apps from directly clearing other apps\' cache or killing background processes without root. LagLess performs only safe, allowed optimizations.
